name: input_digit_suppression_v18
method: Reasoning-driven direct weight-space programming without training
hypothesis: Reflecting the reference ligand reverses all 30 defined centers in three diagnostic systems but changes none of their predicted R/S assignments, for either base or v15. Generic ligand atom-name digits may therefore supply a competing learned prior. Suppress the entire second-character digit embedding in the input encoder, rather than only its coordinate-parallel component as in v4. Standard protein heavy atoms do not use these columns. This is an ablation of the atom-name hypothesis, not an established correction.
